svg.aria-label: Gravitone: Named after gravity + tone. Gravity holds planets in one orbit; this holds every phone on one beat. Every phone and laptop in a room becomes one speaker, in sync to the millisecond. Private beta. Built with Go, WebSocket, Web Audio, Next.js.
